chunks.text: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth is an Equity Linked Savings Scheme (ELSS) that qualifies for tax deduction under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act, up to ₹1.5 lakh per year. It has a mandatory lock-in period of 3 years (mandatory under Section 80C). The exit load is Nil since redemption before lock-in expiry is not permitted.
